title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2611.19429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. translated_title: 为开放词汇查询做更轻量、更快速的准备：一种面向高斯泼溅的逐查询3D分割器
translated_abstract: 开放词汇3D理解旨在对超出预定义类别的任意物体进行定位与分割。然而，现有基于高斯泼溅的方法通常依赖代价高昂的预处理和冗长的训练，限制了其在需要快速、轻量化解决方案场景下的适用性。我们提出了一种轻量级、免训练的框架，用于基于查询的高斯泼溅3D实例分割。与传统基于掩码的CLIP嵌入不同，我们使用密集的像素级CLIP特征来保留细粒度的语义信息，从而实现灵活的文本驱动定位，而无需依赖预定义的实例提议。给定一个文本查询，我们在精心选取的枢轴视图中识别出高质量的目标区域，并借助视频分割器将其跨视图传播，从而为目标实例提供一致且全面的覆盖。随后，我们通过一种新颖的视...（将得到的2D轨迹提升到3D高斯上。）
tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练的轻量级框架，利用密集像素级CLIP特征、枢轴视图选择与跨视图视频分割传播，将2D轨迹提升至3D高斯，实现快速高效的文本查询驱动开放词汇3D实例分割。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a training-free, lightweight query-driven framework that leverages dense pixel-level CLIP features, pivot-view selection, and cross-view video segmentation propagation to lift 2D tracklets onto 3D Gaussians, enabling fast and efficient open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting.
